summary: ETAP 3/4/5 frontend testing. Verified: login (tester@pinonmap.dev), English default, Home Quick Access = 2/row with readable text (all 10 tiles visible with correct testIDs quick-map/explore/planner/nearby/search/area/statistics/missions/events/premium), Explore infinite scroll works (init 24 -> after scroll 24, then load-more-btn present and click extends to 48), Search screen (search-input+search-submit for 'Praga' returns search-result-* and shows search-mode-location + search-cat-* chips), Route Planner (Warsaw start -> Krakow end via Nominatim: route-summary '301 km / 3 h 32 min', 6 route-radius-* chips, route-add-<id> candidates -> route-stop-0 added, route-save-btn AND route-save-board-btn present), Missions (14 mission-claim-<code> buttons; claiming m_first_pin shows mission-claimed-msg '+50 XP · First step' and Missions header XP incremented 4,713 -> 4,763), Progress/Statistics (reached via profile-progress-card: level-card visible, xp-value '4,763 XP', 12 stat-* tiles [Visited/Cities/Countries/Pins/Photos/Boards/Followers/Likes received/Routes/Events/Checked in/Save to board], 18 achievement-* items, badges-count '11/18 unlocked', all 4 progress-link-missions/leaderboard/activity/xpRules), Leaderboard (leaderboard-week/month/all chips + leader-row-1 = Tester POM Level 10 4,763 XP; Ania Level 1 93 XP; lukaslord Level 1 39 XP), Profile tab (profile-level 'Level 10 · 4763 XP', profile-progress-card visible), Map tab (map-layer-btn, map-planner-btn, map-area-btn, map-nearby-btn all present; map-layer-sheet opens with 4 map-provider-osm/voyager/topo/satellite), Events (create-event-fab opens Create Event with event-title-input/event-day-0/event-submit-btn/event-time-*/event-duration-2 controls), Nearby (location-denied-banner shown in headless as expected + 6 nearby-radius-* chips), Boards visibility chips reached via my-boards-btn (public/private/premium presence not fully verified in final run — see action item).

ui_bugs.issue: 'my-routes-btn' row is MISSING from Profile screen. grep for 'my-routes-btn' across /app/frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx returns 0 matches. Request explicitly lists it: 'My routes row my-routes-btn'. Users can only reach saved routes via routes/leader path (RoutesScreen exists) but there is no entry point on Profile.

After clicking route-save-btn, the testID 'route-msg' element did NOT appear within 3 s and no confirmation was rendered. Code path: /app/frontend/src/screens/RoutePlannerScreen.tsx:315 renders <View testID="route-msg"> only when `msg` state is truthy. Either the save call failed silently or the msg was cleared too quickly (< 3 s). Please verify save flow (Supabase insert + setMsg) and ensure msg stays visible ≥2 s so users see the confirmation.

issues: Quick Access tiles rendered at 169×150 in 2/row grid, English labels fit inside on 2 lines — good. But FadeIn wrapper may keep off-screen tiles at opacity 0 until they scroll into view; this made Playwright taps on below-fold tiles (quick-statistics, quick-area) fall through to the bottom tab bar. Human touches will scroll first so this is not a real-user bug, but consider replacing FadeIn's opacity gate with a mount-only fade so off-screen tiles remain hit-testable.

action_items: Add 'my-routes-btn' row to /app/frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx that navigates to RoutesScreen (label e.g. 'My routes'). Request explicitly asks for it.

Fix route save confirmation: after route-save-btn (and route-save-board-btn) success, set `msg` state so the <View testID="route-msg"> renders for at least 2–3 s. Verify Supabase insert into user_routes / pom_routes succeeds and returns a row.
Optional UX: keep FadeIn's opacity animation but ensure pointerEvents='auto' on the wrapper so off-screen quick-access tiles remain tappable even before entering the viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: HomeScreen QuickAccess grid computes tile width from useWindowDimensions and Math.min(winW,600) — correct for mobile-first sizing (2×169px tiles on 390 viewport).
StatisticsScreen returns a loading spinner while `getProgress()` resolves; consumer testing agents should wait ≥3 s after landing on the screen to avoid seeing 0 testIDs.
Leaderboard aggregates from Supabase RPC and correctly renders 3 rows (Tester #1 4,763 XP after +50 XP mission claim during this test).
RoutePlannerScreen: route-save-btn onPress does not surface a durable confirmation UI (route-msg only conditional on `msg` truthy) — this is why the test could not observe post-save state.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% of the listed Stage 3/4/5 flows verified end-to-end; 2 defects (my-routes-btn missing, route-msg not shown after save) and Playwright-only clickability caveat for off-screen tiles

seed_data_creation: During testing: 1 mission was claimed on tester's account (m_first_pin, +50 XP -> total 4,763 XP). No boards / routes / events were created (route-save-btn click did not confirm; the earlier stop 'Majdan' was added into the working planner state only, not necessarily persisted).

MISSING: my-routes-btn on Profile. FLAKY/BUG: route-msg (conditional render — did not appear after save-btn click). Playwright caveat: FadeIn on Home Quick Access tiles seems to leave off-screen tiles at opacity 0, so quick-statistics / quick-area / quick-missions tapped via force=True land on the bottom tab underneath — either scroll them into viewport first with element.scroll_into_view_if_needed() OR reach Statistics via tab-profile -> profile-progress-card as I did.
rca_of_issue: 1) my-routes-btn missing: grep of /app/frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx contains no such testID; the row was never wired. Fix: add a TouchableOpacity with testID='my-routes-btn' next to 'my-boards-btn' that navigates to 'routes' screen. 2) route-msg not visible: /app/frontend/src/screens/RoutePlannerScreen.tsx:315 renders `msg && <View testID="route-msg">…</View>`. During test the msg state never became truthy (or was cleared before assert), likely because the save handler either short-circuits (e.g., insert threw and only setErr was called) or the setTimeout that clears msg is too short. Reproduce: on planner, fill Warsaw->Krakow, add one stop, click route-save-btn — no confirmation banner appears. Mitigation: setMsg on Supabase insert success and keep msg for ≥2000 ms, or render both err/msg with distinct testIDs (route-err, route-msg) so the test can distinguish failure vs success.
